links.outcome: Blinded GP-rated note quality (PDQI-9) including accuracy and thoroughness for AI scribes versus human notes
links.effect: Top AI scribes scored 44.08/50 (SD 3.32) vs 37.42 (SD 9.78) for humans; thoroughness M=4.92, accuracy M=4.67. Only top scribes are reported; accuracy ICC 0.745.
links.quote: Top AI scribes scored a mean of 44.08/50 (SD = 3.32) vs. 37.42 (SD = 9.78) for humans, excelling in thoroughness (M = 4.92), accuracy (M = 4.67), and freedom from bias (M = 4.92).

screen.reason: Compares documentation quality between four commercial AI scribes and human-generated notes across simulated general practice scenarios.
